name: ImRabo Connector Registry
description: Curated catalog of public hosted MCP connectors that work with ImRabo's Streamable HTTP client. Free access is distinguished from account-authenticated access.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Official GitHub MCP server for repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, and Actions. Free GitHub account; authenticate with a fine-grained personal access token. Token permissions determine access.

connectors.name: Cloudflare Documentation
connectors.description: Official public, no-auth MCP server for searching and reading Cloudflare developer documentation. No account or API key required.

connectors.name: Context7 Documentation
connectors.description: Public MCP endpoint for current, version-specific library and framework documentation. No API key required for basic public access; service limits may apply.

connectors.name: draw.io Diagrams
connectors.description: Official hosted draw.io MCP server for creating editable diagrams. No account or sign-in required.

connectors.name: DeepWiki
connectors.description: Community-hosted public MCP endpoint for asking questions about public GitHub repositories and reading generated repository documentation. No sign-in required; availability and usage limits are controlled by the provider.

connectors.name: OpenAI Developer Documentation
connectors.description: Official public, read-only documentation MCP for OpenAI developer platform, API, and ChatGPT developer documentation. No API key required.

connectors.name: Microsoft Learn
connectors.description: Official public MCP for searching Microsoft Learn documentation, retrieving articles, and searching code samples. No authentication or charge required.

connectors.name: Microchip Product Data
connectors.description: Official public MCP for Microchip product specifications, inventory, lead times, documentation, and compliance data. No authentication or charge required.

connectors.name: Microchip MPLAB Documentation
connectors.description: Official public semantic search MCP for Microchip technical documentation, code examples, videos, training, and reference designs. No authentication required.

connectors.name: Renesas Web Data
connectors.description: Official public MCP for Renesas product families, datasheets, orderable parts, lifecycle status, inventory, and cross references. No account, API key, or installation required.

connectors.name: MDN Web Docs
connectors.description: Mozilla's experimental public MCP for MDN web platform documentation, search, and browser compatibility data. No authentication required; query analytics are collected and the experiment may be withdrawn.

connectors.name: Open Targets Platform
connectors.description: Official hosted MCP for Open Targets biomedical target-disease and drug-target evidence data. Public platform data; no API key required. Experimental service.

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.description: Official GitLab MCP server available on GitLab Free, Premium, and Ultimate. Supports project, issue, merge request and GitLab operations. Requires GitLab authorization; OAuth is recommended, or use a fine-grained personal access token with MCP tool execute permission.
